WITH client_by_district AS (
  SELECT 
    d.district_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) as client_count
  FROM district d
  JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
  GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(client_count) as total_clients,
    COUNT(*) as num_districts
  FROM client_by_district
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
  cbd.region,
  AVG(cbd.client_count) as avg_clients_per_district,
  AVG(CAST(cbd.client_count AS REAL) / rt.total_clients) as avg_share_per_district
FROM client_by_district cbd
JOIN region_totals rt ON cbd.region = rt.region
GROUP BY cbd.region
